reviewed_by: Codex source/instruction review; independent human/agent critic not performed

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Exact entry 0x0048F0D0, ten bytes, one block. BN and r2 bytes agree; angr recovers the exact entry without unresolved jumps.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: mov eax,[esp+4] loads one cdecl word. WinMain pushes EBP at 0x0048F5F9 and calls here at 0x0048F5FA after StoreCommandLine. The candidate passes/returns a 32-bit void*; no original source typedef is claimed.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: No arithmetic, conversion or scaling. The absolute retail store destination is 0x005C8BC0.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The only data-memory effect is a four-byte store. There is no dereference of the argument. Candidate InstanceHandle is its own mapped global, not a blind retail absolute address.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No callees or window API calls occur in this native. Natural capture must check actual module-base instance alias, destination and neighboring bytes; controlled replay checks all seeded global transitions and restores state.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The argument bits remain in EAX through ret. No null/error branch or invented zero return is allowed.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Only integer-word moves and ret; no floating point operation.

runtime_contract.note: Controlled pre-resume word-copy replay only; the natural instance-handle call is a separate required observation. No arbitrary word is dereferenced.
